title: Derived tensor cohomology vanishing passes to retracts
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E,K objects of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose there are maps i:E\to K and r:K\to E with i followed by r equal to the identity of E. For any module sheaf G and integer n, if H^n(K\otimes^L G) vanishes in the sense of [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes], then H^n(E\otimes^L G) vanishes in the same sense.

proof.text: Import the existing private tensor_vanishes_iff theorem from the module of lem-pc-tor-amplitude-open-local using import all. This K-flat comparison identifies the vanishing predicate with zero homology of the derived tensor object; do not duplicate its exists_kFlat_model, tensor_model_iso, or tensor_vanishes_iff helpers.

Apply tensor-right by G[0] and then the n-th homology functor to the retract. Its identity factors through the zero homology object for K, so is zero. The K-flat comparison converts this zero object back to the existential vanishing predicate.

proof_origin.note: Lean realization by Q1, repaired after the duplicate-helper return: reuse TorAmplitudeOpenLocal.tensor_vanishes_iff by import all; the retraction argument remains unchanged.
